newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Jan-May non-guaranteed corporate bonds up.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Jan-May non-guaranteed corporate bonds up.

text.p: South Korea's non-guaranteed corporate bond issues surged 94.9 percent to 1.9616 trillion won in the first five months of this year from 1.0063 trillion a year ago, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Friday.
However, guaranteed corporate bond issues fell 10.8 percent to 10.6530 trillion won in the first five months from 11.9469 trillion a year before, a statement from the watchdog said.
It said local banks remained cautious over providing guarantees following a string of corporate failures this year, which triggered the rise in the non-guaranteed corporate bond issues.
Total corporate bonds issues in January to May stood at 12.6146 trillion against 12.9532 trillion a year earlier, it said.
